edit.description: relocationInvariants erases an `at` locus's added exclusions as it erases root and glob, so isRelocationOf holds for an excluding relocation
the new and kept relocation-collision cases

summary: A relocation that adds exclusions to a built-in replaces it, so a member built from the base kind (playbook, defaultPatterns) is governed by the relocation instead of refused
acceptance: SDK gate green with: a harness relocating `rule` with an `exclude` emits beside a member built from the built-in `rule`, governed by the relocation (new); two diverging relocations of one kind still refuse (kept)
notes: SDK-only behavior, so no tests[] line (PROTOCOL, Tests, question 2). Erase only what a relocation may add: the base's own exclusions must remain a subset of the relocation's, or a third kind of the name slips through.
